gloss: no matter what; whatever the circumstances

definitions.gloss: no matter what; whatever happens; at all costs
definitions.explanation: States that the speaker's intention or the outcome will not change however things turn out. Used with strong determination or firm refusal, and often paired with a negative or a volitional form.

examples.japanese: どうあってもその{条件|じょうけん}はのめない。
examples.english: I cannot accept those terms whatever the circumstances.

examples.japanese: どうあっても{約束|やくそく}は{守|まも}るつもりだから、{何|なに}があっても{明日|あした}までに{仕上|しあ}げる。
examples.english: I intend to keep my promise no matter what, so I'll finish it by tomorrow whatever happens.

notes:
USAGE:
Literally "however things may be." It is emphatic and a little formal or literary, so it stands out in casual conversation; {絶対|ぜったい}に is the everyday equivalent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どうあっても〜つもりだ: to intend to do something no matter what
- どうあっても〜ない: will not do something under any circumstances
- どうあっても{譲|ゆず}れない: cannot yield on this whatever happens

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {何|なに}があっても: no matter what happens — focuses on events, not on how things stand
- どうしても: no matter how hard one tries; by all means — much more common, and also used of impossibility
- いずれにしても: in any case — resigned acceptance rather than determination
